camera.backend_pixel_centres: verify per backend; do not silently reuse fixture K

color.physical_compositing_domain: linear RGB with explicit primaries/white point and exposure convention
color.legacy_rgb_primaries: not physically calibrated; declare the working RGB convention in each experiment
color.appearance_baseline_domain: may use fixed developed RGB, labelled as such

legacy_aov_adapter.depth: ray distance t, zero on miss; Z=t/sqrt(1+((u-cx)/fx)^2+((v-cy)/fy)^2)
legacy_aov_adapter.normal: decode 2*encoded-1; world-space face-forward normal; separate geometric/shading normal in new exporter
legacy_aov_adapter.albedo: type-dependent material color, not universally diffuse reflectance
legacy_aov_adapter.material_parameters: diffuse reflectance / conductor F0 / IOR / absorption and transmission semantics must be distinct

cache_invalidation.basis_validity: Only lighting inside the declared basis/domain is allowed without rebuilding.
